claim: multi_extract.py text subcommand uses pandoc as the backend for DOCX files
sub_question: Which backend does multi_extract.py text use for DOCX files?
evidence: Module docstring lists DOCX/EPUB backend as pandoc; cmd_text routes docx to _pandoc_to_text which runs pandoc -t plain.
notes: Confirmed in cmd_text: if fmt in ("docx", "epub"): text = _pandoc_to_text(path); _pandoc_to_text runs ["pandoc", str(path), "-t", "plain", "--wrap=none"].
